en.t: The army of Cyrus the Great of Persia conquer Babylon, ending the Neo-Babylonian Empire. (Julian calendar)
en.s: Cyrus II of Persia (c. 600 – 530 BC), commonly known as Cyrus the Great, was the founder of the Achaemenid Empire. Hailing from Persis, he brought the Achaemenid dynasty to power by defeating the Median Empire and embracing all of the previous civilized states of the ancient Near East, expanding vastly across most of West Asia and much of Central Asia to create what would soon become the largest empire in history at the time.

zh.t: 波斯居鲁士大帝的军队征服巴比伦，终结新巴比伦帝国（儒略历）
zh.s: 波斯居鲁士二世（约公元前600年至前530年），通常称为居鲁士大帝，是阿契美尼德帝国的建立者。他来自波斯地区，击败米底王国并接纳古代近东此前各文明国家，使阿契美尼德王朝掌权。帝国随后大幅扩张，覆盖西亚大部和中亚广大地区，并很快成为当时历史上疆域最大的帝国。

en.s: The Battle of Hatfield Chase (Old English: Hæðfeld; Old Welsh: Meigen) was fought on 12 October 633 at Hatfield Chase near Doncaster (today part of South Yorkshire, England). It pitted the Northumbrians against an alliance of Gwynedd and Mercia. The Northumbrians were led by Edwin and the Gwynedd-Mercian alliance was led by Cadwallon ap Cadfan and Penda. The site was a marshy area about 8 miles (13 km) northeast of Doncaster on the south bank of the River Don. It was a decisive victory for Gwynedd and the Mercians: Edwin was killed and his army defeated, leading to the temporary collapse of Northumbria.

zh.s: 哈特菲尔德蔡斯之战（古英语：Hæðfeld；古威尔士语：Meigen）于633年10月12日在哈特菲尔德蔡斯爆发，地点靠近唐卡斯特（今属英格兰南约克郡）。交战双方是诺森布里亚军队，以及格温内斯和麦西亚的联盟军。诺森布里亚军队由埃德温率领，格温内斯—麦西亚联军由卡德瓦隆·阿普·卡德凡和彭达率领。战场是一片沼泽地，位于唐卡斯特东北约8英里（13公里）、顿河以南。格温内斯和麦西亚取得决定性胜利：埃德温阵亡，诺森布里亚军队被击败，诺森布里亚因此暂时瓦解。

en.t: The Nichiren Shōshū branch of Buddhism is founded in Japan
en.s: Nichiren Shōshū (日蓮正宗; English: The Orthodox School of Nichiren) is a branch of Nichiren Buddhism based on the traditionalist teachings of the 13th century Japanese Buddhist priest Nichiren (1222–1282), claiming him as its founder through his senior disciple Nikko Shonin (1246–1333), the founder of Head Temple Taiseki-ji, near Mount Fuji. The lay adherents of the sect are called Hokkeko members.

zh.s: 日莲正宗（日莲正宗；英文：The Orthodox School of Nichiren）是日莲佛教的一个宗派，遵循13世纪日本僧人日莲（1222—1282）的传统教义，并通过其首席弟子日兴上人（1246—1333）尊日莲为创始人。日兴上人创立了位于富士山附近的大石寺总本山。该宗派的在家信众称为法华讲成员。

en.s: The brief Alexandrian Crusade, also called the sack of Alexandria, occurred in October 1365 and was led by King Peter I of Cyprus against Alexandria in Egypt. The Crusade was sanctioned by Pope Urban V at the request of Peter I. Although often referred to as and counted among the Crusades, it was relatively devoid of religious impetus and differs from the more prominent Crusades in that it seems to have been motivated largely by economic interests.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 亚历山大十字军东征又称亚历山大劫掠，于1365年10月发生，由塞浦路斯国王彼得一世率军进攻埃及亚历山大。教宗乌尔班五世应彼得一世请求批准了这次远征。尽管它常被归入十字军东征，但宗教动机并不突出，与其他著名十字军东征不同，这次行动似乎主要出于经济利益。

en.s: Treaty of Salynas (German: Frieden von Sallinwerder, Lithuanian: Salyno sutartis) was a peace treaty signed on 12 October 1398 by the Grand Duke of Lithuania Vytautas the Great and the Grand Master of the Teutonic Knights Konrad von Jungingen. It was signed on an islet of the Neman River, probably between Kulautuva and the mouth of the Nevėžis River. It was the third time, after the Treaty of Königsberg (1384) and Treaty of Lyck (1390), that Vytautas promised Samogitia to the Knights. The territory was important to the Knights as it physically separated the Teutonic Knights in Prussia from its branch in Livonia.

zh.s: 萨利纳斯条约（德语：Frieden von Sallinwerder；立陶宛语：Salyno sutartis）于1398年10月12日签署。签署双方是立陶宛大公维陶塔斯大帝和条顿骑士团大团长康拉德·冯·容宁根。条约在涅曼河一座小岛上签署，位置可能在库劳图瓦和涅韦日斯河河口之间。这是维陶塔斯第三次承诺将萨莫吉希亚割让给骑士团，此前分别是1384年《柯尼斯堡条约》和1390年《利克条约》。这片领土对骑士团很重要，因为它将普鲁士的条顿骑士团领地与利沃尼亚分部实际分隔开来。

en.s: The Loire Campaign was a campaign launched by Joan of Arc during the Hundred Years' War. The Loire was cleared of all English and Burgundian troops.

en.s: The Rout of Ludford Bridge was a largely bloodless confrontation fought in the early years of the Wars of the Roses. It took place on 12 October 1459, and resulted in a setback for the Yorkists. Although this seemed to be a triumph for the rival Lancastrians at the time, they had thrown away their advantage within six months.

zh.s: 拉德福德桥溃败是玫瑰战争早期一场几乎没有流血的对峙，发生于1459年10月12日。约克派遭到挫败。当时这似乎是对手兰开斯特派的胜利，但他们在六个月内就丧失了优势。

en.s: The Assault on Vatikivi (Swedish: Anfallet på Vatikivi; Russian: Нападение на Ватикиви) was a failed Swedish attempt to dislodge a Russian force that was blockading the Swedish defenders at Viborg from their positions at Vatikivi during the Russo-Swedish War (1495–1497).

zh.s: 瓦蒂基维突袭（瑞典语：Anfallet på Vatikivi；俄语：Нападение на Ватикиви）是瑞典在1495至1497年俄瑞战争期间的一次行动，但未能驱逐俄军。俄军从瓦蒂基维阵地封锁了维堡的瑞典守军，瑞典试图打破封锁但未能成功。

en.s: The Battle of Haddorp, also known as the Massacre in Haddorp was a surprise attack led by royal troops under the command of Botvid Larsson and Abraham Eriksson on a rebel camp in the village of Haddorp, Sweden.

zh.s: 哈多普之战又称哈多普大屠杀，是皇家军队突袭瑞典哈多普村一处叛军营地的行动，由博特维德·拉尔松和亚伯拉罕·埃里克松指挥。

en.s: The Toungoo–Mrauk-U War (Burmese: တောင်ငူ–မြောက်ဦး စစ်) was a military conflict that took place in Arakan (present-day Rakhine State of Myanmar) from 1545 to 1547 between the Toungoo Dynasty and the Kingdom of Mrauk U. The western kingdom successfully fended off the Toungoo invasions, and kept its independence. The war had a deterrence effect: Mrauk U would not see another Toungoo invasion until 1580.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 东吁—妙乌战争（缅甸语：တောင်ငူ–မြောက်ဦး စစ်）是1545年至1547年间发生在若开邦（今缅甸若开邦）的军事冲突，交战双方为东吁王朝和妙乌王国。妙乌王国成功抵御东吁入侵，保住了独立。此后，东吁直到1580年才再次入侵妙乌。

en.s: The Ottomans laid siege to the city of Eger (Turkish: Eğri), that lasted from September 20 to October 12, 1596, as part of the Long War, successfully conquering it after the 7,000 defenders of the fortress, mostly foreign mercenaries, were killed by the Ottoman forces commanded by the Sultan Mehmed III himself, who had arrived with the main Ottoman Army from Constantinople.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 奥斯曼军队于1596年9月20日至10月12日围攻埃格尔城（匈牙利语：Eger），这是长期战争的一部分。奥斯曼军队成功攻占该城，并杀死了堡垒内7,000名守军，其中大多数是外国雇佣兵。奥斯曼苏丹穆罕默德三世本人率领主力军从君士坦丁堡赶到。

en.s: The Battle of Listenhoff was fought during the Polish–Swedish War (1621–1625), between Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and the Swedish Empire in October 12, 1625. Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth forces under the command of Aleksander Gosiewski defeated the Swedish forces commanded by Gustav Horn.

zh.s: 波兰—瑞典战争（1621—1625年）期间，波兰立陶宛联邦与瑞典帝国于1625年10月12日在拉脱维亚交战。亚历山大·戈谢夫斯基率领的波兰立陶宛联邦军队击败了古斯塔夫·霍恩率领的瑞典军队。

en.s: The unsuccessful second siege of Hull by the Royalist Earl of Newcastle in 1643 was a victory for Parliament at the high point of the Royalist campaign in the First English Civil War. It led to the abandonment of the Earl of Newcastle's campaign in Lincolnshire and the re-establishment of Parliament's presence in Yorkshire.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1643年，纽卡斯尔伯爵率领保王党军队第二次围攻赫尔，但未能攻下。议会派在英国内战中取得胜利，此时正是保王党攻势的高峰。这场失败导致纽卡斯尔伯爵放弃林肯郡战役，并使议会派重新控制约克郡。

en.s: On the morning of October 12, 1654, a gunpowder magazine exploded in Delft, destroying buildings across the city. The disaster became known as the Delft Thunderclap.

zh.s: 1654年10月12日上午，荷兰代尔夫特的一座火药库发生爆炸，城内大片建筑被毁。这场灾难后来被称为“代尔夫特惊雷”。

en.s: The Battle of Woerden, also known as the Battle of Kruipin, took place on the night of 11 October to 12 October 1672 during the Franco-Dutch War. The battle was fought a few hundred metres north of Woerden at Fort Kruipin between the Dutch Republic and France. The battle was fought for the possession of the town of Woerden.

zh.s: 伍尔登之战又称克鲁伊平之战，于1672年10月11日至12日夜间法荷战争期间爆发。交战双方是荷兰共和国和法国，战场位于伍尔登以北数百米处的克鲁伊平堡。双方争夺伍尔登镇的控制权。

en.s: The second conquest of Franche-Comté, also known as the definitive conquest of Franche-Comté, was a military campaign during the Dutch War that took place in the Franche-Comté region from 12 October 1673 to 10 July 1674, culminating in the capture of the Château de Sainte-Anne. This conflict pitted France against the County of Burgundy, then a possession of the Spanish House of Habsburg and part of the Holy Roman Empire.

zh.s: 第二次征服弗朗什-孔泰又称弗朗什-孔泰最终征服，是荷兰战争期间的一次军事行动，于1673年10月12日至1674年7月10日在弗朗什-孔泰地区进行，最终攻占圣安娜城堡。交战双方是法国与勃艮第伯国；后者当时属于西班牙哈布斯堡王朝，是神圣罗马帝国的一部分。

en.s: The Battle of Khed took place on 12 October 1707, between Shahu I and the forces of Tarabai led by Dhanaji Jadhav. The battle occurred at Khed, situated near the Bhima river to the north of Pune.

zh.s: 1707年10月12日，沙胡一世与塔拉拜麾下由达纳吉·贾达夫率领的军队交战。战斗发生在浦那以北、比玛河附近的赫德。

en.s: The siege of Temeşvar took place from 31 August to 12 October 1716 during the Austro-Turkish War of 1716-1718, to liberate the last regions of Ottoman-occupied Hungary. The Habsburg army led by Prince Eugene of Savoy, who had just won a crushing victory at Petrovaradin, managed to capture the Ottoman fortress of Temeşvar (today Timișoara, Romania), the capital of the Banat since 1552 and the last Turkish stronghold in Temeşvar Eyalet.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 奥土战争期间，蒂米什瓦拉围城战于1716年8月31日至10月12日进行，目标是解放仍被奥斯曼帝国占领的匈牙利最后几个地区。萨伏依亲王尤金刚在彼得罗瓦拉丁取得压倒性胜利，随后率领哈布斯堡军队攻占奥斯曼帝国的蒂米什瓦拉要塞。该城自1552年以来一直是巴纳特的首府，也是蒂米什瓦拉省最后一处土耳其据点。

en.s: The Battle of Havana was fought between 12–14 October 1748 off Havana between the British and Spanish navies during the War of Jenkins' Ear. A British squadron under Rear-Admiral of the Red Charles Knowles attacked a Spanish squadron led by Lieutenant-general Andrés Reggio during an attempt by Knowles to intercept the Spanish treasure fleet.

zh.s: 英国和西班牙海军于1748年10月12日至14日在哈瓦那附近交战，是詹金斯耳朵战争期间的一场海战。查尔斯·诺尔斯红色中将率领英国分舰队，在试图拦截西班牙宝船队时，袭击了安德烈斯·雷吉奥中将率领的西班牙分舰队。

en.s: The Battle of Fort Ligonier (also known as the Battle of Loyalhanna or the Battle of Loyal Hannon) was a battle of the French and Indian War. On 12 October 1758, French and Indian forces directed from nearby Fort Duquesne were repulsed in an attack on the British outpost of Fort Ligonier, then still under construction.

zh.s: 利戈尼尔堡之战又称洛亚尔汉纳之战，是法国与印第安人战争期间的一场战斗。1758年10月12日，由附近杜肯堡派出的法国和印第安人部队袭击英国前哨利戈尼尔堡，但被击退。当时该堡仍在修建中。

en.s: The Raid on Berlin took place in October 1760 during the Third Silesian War (part of the Seven Years' War) when Austrian and Russian forces occupied the Prussian capital of Berlin for three full days,—from October 9th until 12th. After raising money from the city, and with the approach of further Prussian reinforcements, the occupiers withdrew.

zh.s: 第三次西里西亚战争（七年战争的一部分）期间，奥地利和俄罗斯军队于1760年10月9日至12日占领普鲁士首都柏林三天。占领军向城市索取钱款后，随着更多普鲁士援军逼近，最终撤离。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: Eastern State Hospital is a psychiatric hospital in Williamsburg, Virginia. Built in 1773, it was the first public facility in the present-day United States constructed solely for the care and treatment of the mentally ill. The original building had burned but was reconstructed in 1985.

zh.t: 美国首家精神病院开业
zh.s: 东部州立医院是一家位于弗吉尼亚州威廉斯堡的精神病医院。该院建于1773年，是如今美国境内首个专门为精神疾病患者提供照护和治疗的公共机构。最初的建筑曾被烧毁，后于1985年重建。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Virginia on October 12, 1787. The incumbent governor of Virginia Edmund Randolph was re-elected. The election was conducted by the Virginia General Assembly in joint session. Randolph was selected by a majority of members on the first ballot; the official record of the proceedings does not include the names or tallied votes for any other candidates.

zh.s: 弗吉尼亚州于1787年10月12日举行州长选举。时任州长埃德蒙·伦道夫再次当选。选举由弗吉尼亚州议会联席会议举行。伦道夫在第一轮投票中获得多数议员支持；官方会议记录没有列出其他候选人的姓名或得票数。

en.s: The 1790 Pennsylvania gubernatorial election was the first gubernatorial election after the establishment of the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania as a U.S. state. Thomas Mifflin, the incumbent President of the Supreme Executive Council of the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania was elected as the first Governor of Pennsylvania. He defeated Federalist candidate Arthur St. Clair, former Revolutionary War general and President of the Continental Congress, by a wide margin.

zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州作为美国一个州成立后，首次举行州长选举。宾夕法尼亚州联邦最高行政委员会时任主席托马斯·米夫林当选首任州长。他以明显优势击败联邦党候选人亚瑟·圣克莱尔；圣克莱尔曾任独立战争将军和大陆会议主席。

en.s: The First Battle of Noirmoutier took place on 12 October 1793 as part of the war in the Vendée. The Vendéens under François de Charette were victorious over the republican troops stationed there.

zh.s: 努瓦尔穆捷第一次战役于1793年10月12日旺代战争期间爆发。弗朗索瓦·德·夏雷特率领的旺代军击败了驻扎在当地的共和军。

en.s: At the Battle of Höchst (11–12 October 1795), the Habsburg Austrian army commanded by François Sébastien Charles Joseph de Croix, Count of Clerfayt outmaneuvered the French Republican Army of Sambre-et-Meuse commanded by Jean-Baptiste Jourdan. Although the French attacked first, they were unable to dislodge an Austrian flanking column. Afterward Jourdan's army retreated to the north.

zh.s: 1795年10月11日至12日的赫赫斯特战役中，弗朗索瓦·塞巴斯蒂安·夏尔·约瑟夫·德克鲁瓦、克莱尔费特伯爵率领的哈布斯堡奥地利军队，以机动作战胜过让-巴蒂斯特·儒尔当率领的桑布尔—默兹法国共和军。法国军队首先发动进攻，但未能击退奥军侧翼纵队。战后，儒尔当的军队向北撤退。

en.s: The Battle of Tory Island (also known as the Battle of Donegal, Battle of Lough Swilly or Warren's Action) was a naval action of the French Revolutionary Wars, fought on 12 October 1798 between French and British squadrons off the northwest coast of County Donegal, then in the Kingdom of Ireland.

zh.s: 托里岛之战又称多尼戈尔之战、斯威利湖之战或沃伦海战，是法国大革命战争期间的一场海战。法国和英国舰队于1798年10月12日在当时属于爱尔兰王国的多尼戈尔郡西北海岸外交战。

en.t: The Peasants’ War breaks out in Overmere
en.s: On October 12, 1798, the seizure of property over unpaid taxes in Overmere sparked an uprising against French rule, marking the outbreak of the Peasants’ War.
en.n: This entry records the outbreak at Overmere, in present-day Belgium.

en.s: The Irish Rebellion of 1798 (Irish: Éirí Amach 1798; Ulster Scots: "The Turn Out"/"The Hurries") was a popular insurrection against the British Crown in what was then the separate, but subordinate, Kingdom of Ireland. The main organising force was the Society of United Irishmen. First formed in Belfast by Presbyterians opposed to the landed Anglican establishment, the Society, despairing of reform, sought to secure a republic through a revolutionary union with the country's Catholic majority.

en.t: Battle of the Head of Passes
en.s: The Battle of the Head of Passes was a bloodless naval battle of the American Civil War. It was a naval raid made by the Confederate river defense fleet, also known as the “mosquito fleet” in the local media, on ships of the Union Blockade squadron anchored at the Head of Passes. The mosquito fleet was supported by three fire rafts, which were ignited and followed the ironclad ram CSS Manassas into the action. The attack occurred after moonset in the early hours of October 12, 1861, and routed the Union fleet, which fled in disorder down the Southwest pass of the delta.

en.s: Since the 1870s, various pieces of colonial legislation in India during British rule were collectively called the Criminal Tribes Act (CTA). en.s: The First Battle of Passchendaele took place on 12 October 1917, in the Ypres Salient of the Western Front, west of Passchendaele village. The attack was part of the Third Battle of Ypres in the First World War. The British had planned to capture the ridges south and east of the city of Ypres as part of a strategy decided by the Allies at conferences in November 1916 and May 1917. Passchendaele lay on the last ridge east of Ypres, 5 miles (8.0 km) from a railway junction at Roulers, which was an important part of the German 4th Army supply system.

zh.s: 第一次帕森达勒战役于1917年10月12日在第一次世界大战西线伊普尔突出部、帕森达勒村以西爆发，是第三次伊普尔战役的一部分。英国计划攻占伊普尔以南和以东的山脊，相关战略由盟军在1916年11月和1917年5月的会议上制定。帕森达勒位于伊普尔以东最后一道山脊上，距鲁瑟拉勒铁路枢纽5英里（8公里）；该枢纽是德国第四集团军补给系统的重要组成部分。

en.t: Wildfires devastate Cloquet and nearby Minnesota communities
en.s: On October 12, 1918, strong winds drove wildfires through northeastern Minnesota, devastating Cloquet, Moose Lake and nearby communities. A fire near Cloquet had started two days earlier.
en.n: October 12 marks the destructive outbreak; the fire near Cloquet had begun on October 10.

zh.t: 野火重创克洛凯及明尼苏达州周边社区
zh.s: 1918年10月12日，强风推动野火席卷明尼苏达州东北部，克洛凯、穆斯湖及周边社区遭到严重破坏。克洛凯附近的一处火灾在两天前就已燃起。

en.s: A Conservative leadership convention was held on October 12, 1927 at the Winnipeg Amphitheatre in Winnipeg, Manitoba. The convention was held to choose a new leader of the Conservative Party (formally the Liberal-Conservative Party) to choose a successor to former Prime Minister of Canada Arthur Meighen who had led the party since 1920. This was the first time the Conservatives used a leadership convention to choose a leader. Previous leaders had been chosen by the party's caucus, the previous leader, or by the Governor General of Canada designating an individual to form a government after his predecessor's death or resignation.

zh.t: 1927年加拿大保守党领袖选举大会
zh.s: 加拿大保守党于1927年10月12日在马尼托巴省温尼伯的温尼伯圆形剧场举行领袖选举大会，选出新任党魁，接替自1920年以来领导该党的前加拿大总理阿瑟·米恩。该党当时的正式名称是自由保守党。这是保守党首次通过领袖选举大会选出党魁。此前，党魁由党团、前任党魁选定，或由加拿大总督在前任去世或辞职后指定一人组建政府。

en.s: The 1927 Football Association Charity Shield was the 14th FA Charity Shield, an annual English association football match. en.s: A House-only Federal Election was held in Australia on 12 October 1929. All 75 seats in the House of Representatives were up for election, but there was no Senate election. The election was caused by the defeat of the Bruce-Page Government in the House of Representatives over the Maritime Industries Bill, Bruce having declared that the vote on the bill would constitute a vote of confidence in his government. With senators having fixed six-year terms, the terms of those senators elected in 1926 were not due to expire until 1932.

en.t: The Soviet Union launches the Voskhod 1 into Earth orbit as the first spacecraft with a multi-person crew, and the first flight without pressure suits
en.s: Voskhod 1 (Russian: Восход-1, lit. 'Sunrise-1') was the seventh crewed Soviet space flight. Flown by cosmonauts Vladimir Komarov, Konstantin Feoktistov, and Boris Yegorov, it launched 12 October 1964, and returned on the 13th. en.s: Operation Gown (Hebrew: כתונת‎‎, Ketonet), was a military operation conducted deep inside Syria by Sayeret Tzanhanim, the reconnaissance platoon of the Israeli Defense Forces' Paratroopers Brigade. en.s: The 1996 New Zealand general election was held on 12 October 1996 to determine the composition of the 45th New Zealand Parliament. It was notable for being the first election to be held under the new mixed-member proportional (MMP) electoral system, and produced a parliament considerably more diverse than previous elections. It saw the National Party, led by Jim Bolger, retain its position in government, but only after protracted negotiations with the smaller New Zealand First party to form a coalition. New Zealand First's position as "kingmaker", able to place either of the two major parties into government, was a significant election outcome.

zh.s: 新西兰于1996年10月12日举行大选，选出第45届议会议员。这是该国首次采用新的混合成员比例代表制，选后议会组成比以往更加多元。吉姆·博尔杰领导的国家党继续执政，但经过长时间谈判后才与新西兰优先党组成联合政府。新西兰优先党因此成为“造王者”，可以决定两大党中的哪一方组建政府，这是此次选举的重要结果。

en.s: On 12 October 2002, three terrorist attacks took place in the tourist district of Kuta on the Indonesian island of Bali. 2 suicide bombings occurred in two popular nightspots in Kuta Beach, the Sari Club and Paddy's Pub, killing a total of 202 people including 151 Western tourists from Australia and Europe as well as 38 local Indonesian residents living or working in businesses or homes around the nightclubs.

en.t: Formally opened on October 12, 2003, it is the first newly built high-speed railway in China, costing CN¥15.7 billion (US$1.9 billion)
en.s: Qinhuangdao–Shenyang passenger railway or Qinshen railway (simplified Chinese: 秦沈客运专线; traditional Chinese: 秦瀋客運專線; pinyin: Qínshěn Kèyùn Zhuānxiàn) is a passenger-dedicated high-speed railway between Qinhuangdao, Hebei province and Shenyang, Liaoning province of China, spanning a distance of 404 km (251 mi). Construction started on August 16, 1999. Formally opened on October 12, 2003, it is the first newly built high-speed railway in China, costing CN¥15.7 billion (US$1.9 billion).

zh.s: 秦皇岛—沈阳客运专线又称秦沈铁路，是连接中国河北省秦皇岛市与辽宁省沈阳市的客运专线，全长404公里（251英里）。该铁路于2003年10月12日正式开通，是中国首条新建高速铁路，耗资157亿元人民币（约19亿美元）。工程于1999年8月16日开工。

en.t: The second Chinese human spaceflight, Shenzhou 6, is launched, carrying two cosmonauts in orbit for five days
en.s: Shenzhou 6 (Chinese: 神舟六号; pinyin: Shénzhōu lìuhào) was the second human spaceflight of the Chinese space program, launched on October 12, 2005, on a Long March 2F rocket from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center. The Shenzhou spacecraft carried a crew of Fei Junlong and Nie Haisheng for five days in low Earth orbit. It launched three days before the second anniversary of China's first human spaceflight, Shenzhou 5.

zh.s: 神舟六号是中国第二次载人航天飞行，于2005年10月12日由长征二号F运载火箭从酒泉卫星发射中心发射升空。飞船将费俊龙和聂海胜送入近地轨道，执行为期5天的飞行任务。神舟六号的发射日期比中国首次载人航天飞行神舟五号两周年纪念日早三天。

en.s: The 2013 Rangitikei local elections were held across the Rangitikei District of Manawatu-Wanganui, New Zealand, for the offices of Mayor of Rangitikei and eleven members of the Rangitikei District Council on 12 October 2013. They were held as part of the 2013 New Zealand local elections. Postal ballots were issued to 9,866 registered voters, and were returned from 23 September to 12 October. Across the district, 4,856 people cast votes, a voter turnout of 49.22%. Some voters chose not to vote in particular elections or referendums, so voter turnout in individual elections varies from this figure.

en.s: The 2013 Christchurch mayoral election was part of the New Zealand local elections and was won by former MP Lianne Dalziel. The elections were held on 12 October 2013 for the Mayor of Christchurch plus other local government roles. Incumbent Bob Parker announced 14 months prior to the election that he would seek a third term as mayor. There was much speculation for many months over who would challenge Parker. Dalziel's name was persistently mentioned, but she denied any interest, declaring instead that the job that she really wanted is Gerry Brownlee's as Earthquake Recovery Minister, rather than Bob Parker's.

zh.s: 2013年基督城市长选举是新西兰地方选举的一部分，由前国会议员莉安·达尔齐尔胜出。选举于2013年10月12日举行，选出基督城市长及其他地方政府职位。现任市长鲍勃·帕克在选举前14个月宣布竞选第三个任期。此后数月间，外界一直猜测谁会挑战帕克。达尔齐尔的名字不断被提及，但她否认有意参选，表示自己真正想要的是担任杰里·布朗利的职位——地震恢复部长，而不是接替鲍勃·帕克。

en.s: In the city of Hamilton, New Zealand, elections were held for the offices of Mayor of Hamilton and twelve members of the Hamilton City Council (HCC) on 12 October 2013. Referendums on city water fluoridation and to determine voting method for electing city councillors in the future were held simultaneously. Postal ballots were issued to 97,259 registered voters, and were returned from 23 September to 12 October 2013. Across the city, 37,276 people cast votes, a voter turnout of 38.33%.

en.s: Bound for Glory (2014) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA), in collaboration with Japanese promotion Wrestle-1 (W-1). It took place on October 12, 2014 at the Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan. It was the tenth pay-per-view under the Bound for Glory chronology, the second TNA/W-1 joint event held in Japan in 2014 (following Kaisen: Outbreak), and the fourth and last event in the 2014 TNA PPV schedule. It was the first Bound for Glory to not feature either the NWA World Heavyweight Championship or the TNA World Heavyweight Championship in the main event.

en.s: The 2019 Louisiana gubernatorial election was held to elect the governor of Louisiana. Incumbent Democratic governor John Bel Edwards won re-election to a second term, defeating Republican businessman Eddie Rispone. Edwards became the first Democratic governor of Louisiana to win re-election to a second consecutive term in 44 years since Edwin Edwards (no relation) in 1975. It was the closest Louisiana gubernatorial election since 1979. This was the only Democratic-held governorship up for election in 2019 that Donald Trump won in the 2016 presidential election, and was the only statewide victory in 2019 for Democrats in Louisiana. Under Louisiana's jungle primary system, all candidates appear on the same ballot, regardless of party, and voters may vote for any candidate regardless of their party affiliation. Because no candidate received an absolute majority of the vote during the primary election on October 12, 2019, a runoff election was held on November 16, 2019, between the top two candidates in the primary, Edwards and Rispone.

Incumbent Mayor André Martins, from the Unitary Democratic Coalition (CDU), ran for a second term, facing a tough challenge from Fernando José, from the Socialist Party, and former Mayor Maria das Dores Meira, who was elected as part of the CDU in the past and was supported in this election by the PSD and the CDS–PP, while Chega originally proposed former PSD MP Lina Lopes as the party's mayoral candidate.

en.s: The 2025 Lisbon local election was held on 12 October 2025 to elect the members for Lisbon City Council, Lisbon Municipal Assembly and the city's 24 parish assemblies. en.s: The 2025 Porto local election was held on 12 October 2025 to elect the members for Porto City Council, Porto Municipal Assembly and the city's 7 parish assemblies. This election was expected to be extremely competitive after the 3 mandates of the liberal-backed Independent Rui Moreira, which was barred from running for a 4th term, with both the Socialists and Social Democrats hoping to win the second major city in Portugal, and Moreira's independent movement presenting then deputy mayor Filipe Araújo as a candidate, despite not having the endorsement of Rui Moreira himself.
